First, note the date format is MM-DD-YYYY: 02-20-1638.  
Adding 252 days:  

1638 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 in Gregorian, but 1638 not divisible by 4 anyway).  
From Feb 20:  
Days left in Feb: 8 (since 28 total).  
March: 31, April: 30, May: 31, June: 30, July: 31, August: 31, September: 30.  

Sum stepwise:  
Feb 8 + Mar 31 = 39  
+ Apr 30 = 69  
+ May 31 = 100  
+ Jun 30 = 130  
+ Jul 31 = 161  
+ Aug 31 = 192  
+ Sep 30 = 222 days used.  

252 total − 222 = 30 days remaining into October.  
So new date: October 30, 1638.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1638-10-30
